method: Anchor to the two retained custody-to-custody intervals. Replace measured cold-pipeline, post-custody gate and replay costs with candidate timings; remove one redundant pre-broker replay. Add linear mean-history growth to two full replays and 71 inventory scans per capture. Persistent objects model:56ledger+7metadata+6archive+2working receipts per capture. Original four replays modeled separately for comparison.
limitations: Planning range is an engineering allowance, not a statistical confidence interval.
One retained near/L2/ring-off context was timed; other contexts and host load can change byte volume and runtime.
Future scaling is modeled from record/object counts, not measured through an entire family.
Cold software fixture uses independent metadata copies and sparse placeholders for unrelated archives.
No production family has exercised the new flow; source-profile/authority admission is still required before any new experiment.
Independent scientific validation, Q16c, pilot and Stage18 are excluded.
All59repetitions/cell and fixed5s/1s windows remain unchanged.
